en.headline: Hong Kong Maritime Week begins its tenth anniversary programme
en.dek: The week-long event from 15 to 21 November features more than 60 activities by over 80 organisations, with the opening ceremony set for Monday.
body: Hong Kong Maritime Week 2026 has begun, marking the tenth anniversary of the flagship maritime event running from 15 to 21 November.

The Transport and Logistics Bureau said the programme is expected to attract over 18,000 participants online and offline, with more than 60 events hosted by over 80 local, mainland and overseas organisations. Key highlights include the opening ceremony and World Maritime Merchants Forum on 16 November at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.

The Government plans to announce a new batch of partner ports and sign several maritime-related memoranda of understanding during the week. Public activities include an art container exhibition at the Hong Kong Maritime Museum from 15 to 25 November.

zh.headline: 香港海運週十周年展開 一連七日活動吸引逾萬人參與
zh.dek: 由15至21日舉行，超過80個機構合辦逾60場活動，開幕典禮周一舉行。
body: 香港海運週2026已展開，標誌這項旗艦海運盛事踏入十周年，活動由11月15日至21日舉行。
運輸及物流局表示，預計吸引超過18000名線上線下參加者，逾80家本地、內地及海外機構合辦超過60場活動。重點包括16日在會展中心舉行的開幕典禮暨世界航商大會。
政府將於期間公布新一批夥伴港口，並簽署多項航運相關合作備忘錄。公眾活動包括15至25日在香港海事博物館展出的藝術貨櫃裝置。
